title: Create an Independent List
description:
Write a Python program that reads a list of marks, creates an independent clone of the list, and increases every mark in the clone by 5.

The original list must remain completely unchanged.

### Input Format
A single line containing space-separated integer marks, e.g. `80 70 90 60 75`.

### Output Format
Display two lines:
`Original: <original_list>`
`Updated: <updated_cloned_list>`
requirements: Read space-separated integers using `[int(x) for x in input().split()]` or `list(map(int, input().split()))`.
Create a separate copy of the list using `.copy()` or slicing `[:]`.
Traverse the cloned list and increase every mark by 5.
Ensure the original list is not modified.
starterCode:

hints: Read input: `marks = [int(x) for x in input().split()]`.
Clone the list: `updated_marks = marks.copy()` or `updated_marks = marks[:]`.
Iterate by index to modify the clone: `for i in range(len(updated_marks)): updated_marks[i] += 5`.
Print both: `print('Original:', marks)` followed by `print('Updated:', updated_marks)`.
